per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: Material packet remains material_extracted_with_gaps because supplement/figure limitations are real, but all gate-relevant local values from XML Tables 1-4 and Supplement Table S2 were obtained without fabrication.
per_layer_decision_rationale.validator_contract: The existing packet/complete-message validator contract was structurally ready before this repair; no structural blocker was introduced.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP rows with source-matched labels/targets/values were promoted to source_verified; aggregate or unmapped CAMP/dbAMP rows remain source_conflict/database_only_no_primary_source with explicit context.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 recovered 174 source-located activity/toxicity records, including main XML tables, Table 4, Supplement Table S2, and D2 MIC distribution range summaries.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Worker-6 replaced automated pending-review mechanism placeholders with bounded direct-assay and interpretive claims grounded in time-kill, PMF fluorescence, and macromolecule-biosynthesis sections.
per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_review: The original open ticket is closed because the blocking source-review and missing-activity-row failures are repaired; remaining gaps are explicit cautions and do not require fabricated values.

adjudication_summary: Re-review recovered the previously missing activity/toxicity matrix from local XML/supplement material, reconciled linked database rows without hiding conflicts, and completed a source-reviewed worker-6 final adjudication. The paper is accepted_with_cautions, not accepted_clean.
summary: Source-reviewed rework resolved the blocking missing-activity and missing-adjudication failures for doi__10.3390_molecules24061121 while preserving nonblocking database and supplement-unit cautions.

caution_findings.finding: 33 linked database rows remain source_conflict because database aggregate entries or values cannot be row-verified beyond the local packet.
Supplement Table S2 values were recovered by layout text, but the table body does not print a unit; raw_unit records preserve that missingness.
Figure S2 supports D2 MIC distribution ranges for 100 isolates but no exact per-isolate numeric matrix was locally recoverable.
Mechanism conclusions are limited to the time-kill, PMF fluorescence, and macromolecule-biosynthesis assays; receptor-level speculation remains unverified.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: Supplement Table S2 prints MIC values but no unit in the table body; main-text/database context was not used to overwrite the raw table unit.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Table S2 values are retained with raw_unit=unit_not_reported_in_supplement_table and are not normalized or converted.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: Local material provides a range/distribution figure for 50 S. pseudintermedius and 50 P. aeruginosa isolates but no per-isolate numeric matrix.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Only source-supported MIC ranges are retained as summary records; no individual 100-isolate values were fabricated.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: CAMP/dbAMP aggregate entries in linked_experiment_records contain database sequence IDs but the packet lacks primary sequence/name rows for those database identifiers.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Those database rows are preserved as source_conflict or database_only_no_primary_source rather than converted to source_verified.
